players.bio: Aaron Meijers (born 28 October 1987) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a left back for Eredivisie club FC Volendam.
Alwande Benedict Roaldsøy (born 9 June 2004) is a Norwegian footballer who plays as a midfielder for Dutch Eredivisie club Sparta Rotterdam.

Andrej Kostić (Serbian Cyrillic: Андреј Костић; born 16 January 2007) is a Montenegrin professional footballer who plays as a striker and left winger for Serbian SuperLiga club Partizan and the Montenegro national team. Having completed his transfer to Italian Serie A club AC Milan in March 2026, he will join on 1 July 2026.
Bas Edo Kuipers (born 17 August 1994) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Eredivisie club Sparta Rotterdam.
Boyd Reith (born 5 May 1999) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Eredivisie club Sparta Rotterdam.

Rolando Maximiliano "Bruno" Martins Indi (born 8 February 1992) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a defender for Eredivisie club Sparta Rotterdam. Martins Indi began his career with Dutch club Feyenoord, after progressing through the club's youth teams.
Casper Mikael Terho (born 24 June 2003) is a Finnish professional footballer who plays as a winger for Eredivisie club Sparta Rotterdam and the Finland national team.
Cedric Joriaan Hatenboer (born 19 March 2005) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club Sparta Rotterdam.

Filip Bednarek is a Polish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Eredivisie club Sparta Rotterdam. Bednarek signed with Dutch side FC Twente at the age of 16. He made his debut for FC Twente on 6 December 2012 against Helsingborgs IF in UEFA Europa League. As he never could make it to the first eleven, he left Twente as a free agent in July 2015.
Giannino Vianello is a 19-year-old Dutch-Italian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Sparta Rotterdam in the Dutch Eredivisie.

Isaac Achmed Koroma Junior Babadi (born 6 April 2005) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or a winger for Royal Antwerp on loan from Eredivisie club PSV. Isaac Babadi made his professional debut for Jong PSV on the 10 January 2022, replacing Johan Bakayoko during a 5–1 home Eerste Divisie against Almere City, their largest win of the season at that point.
Jens Toornstra (born 4 April 1989) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays for Eredivisie side Sparta Rotterdam. He usually plays as an attacking midfielder.
Joel Ideho (born 17 July 2003) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a winger for Eredivisie club FC Volendam.
Julian Baas (born 16 April 2002) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club Sparta Rotterdam.
Lushendry Martes (born 6 May 2008) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Eredivisie club Sparta Rotterdam. A Netherlands youth international, Martes is of Curaçao descent.

Marvin Young (born 2 October 2005) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for the Eredivisie club Sparta Rotterdam. Club career A youth product of SV Jong Ambon, he shortly after joined the academy of Sparta Rotterdam at the age of 9 where he continued his development. He started playing with their reserves in the Tweede Divisie, Jong Sparta, in 2023.
Max de Ligt (born 20 July 2004) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Sparta Rotterdam, where he also represents Jong Sparta Rotterdam.[

Milan Zonneveld is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a striker for Eredivisie club Sparta Rotterdam. Club career FC Volendam Zonneveld was born in Beverwijk. He started playing football in the youth at ADO '20, then played at RKVV DEM after which he made the switch to the youth department of FC Volendam. On March 17, 2021, he signed his first professional contract with FC Volendam.

Mitchell van Bergen is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a right winger for the Eredivisie club Sparta Rotterdam. Born on 27 August 1999 in Oss, Netherlands, the 26-year-old is widely known for his blistering pace, acceleration, and dribbling ability on the flanks.
Nick Verschuren is a 21-year-old Dutch professional footballer who plays as a central defender for Eredivisie club Sparta Rotterdam.
Pascal Kuiper (born 17 March 2004) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Sparta Rotterdam,

Rogier Meijer (born 5 September 1981) is a Dutch professional football coach and former player. He is the head coach of Eredivisie club Sparta Rotterdam. As a player, Meijer appeared his entire professional career for De Graafschap as a midfielder. In May 2014, Meijer announced his retirement from professional football.
Shunsuke Mito (born 28 September 2002) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club Sparta Rotterdam and the Japan national team.

Teo Quintero León (born 2 March 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Dutch Eredivisie club Sparta Rotterdam. Born in Spain, he plays for the Venezuela national team.
